question: A dealer marks his goods 20% above the cost price. He then allows a discount on it and makes a profit of 8%. Find the rate of discount offered by the dealer.
solution:
**Given:**

A dealer marks his goods 20% above the cost price.

The dealer then allows a discount on it and makes a profit of 8%.

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Mark-up Percentage)

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit Percentage)

Discount = Marked Price (MP) - Selling Price (SP)

Discount Percentage = (Discount / Marked Price (MP)) × 100
